task.title: Byte-budget expiring recency cache
task.specification: Config capacity>=1. Start now=0 and empty entries. Events put{key,value,size>0,ttl>=0},get{key},advance{dt>=0}. Value is integer. Advance adds dt; delete entries with expiry<=now before handling other operations and after advance. A put with size>capacity does nothing, even if key exists; otherwise remove old key, and if ttl>0 evict oldest recency entries until the new entry fits, then insert it newest with expiry=now+ttl. ttl=0 simply removes that key. A successful get returns value and moves that entry newest; miss returns null. Put and advance value=null. Output {value,keys:[oldest-to-newest],bytes:sum_sizes,now}. Implement pure solve({config,state,event})->{state,output}, initially state=null. Only the current event is supplied; every named event uses a type field, e.g. {type:"restore"}. Return exactly the stated output fields each step; opaque JSON state is not graded. All numeric inputs and intermediate arithmetic are safe integers; time deltas are nonnegative. Unless a task explicitly overrides this, keys, snapshot IDs, readers and graph nodes are single lowercase ASCII letters. Integral JSON number spellings such as 1 and 1.0 are equivalent; booleans remain distinct from numbers. At most eight identities and 48 events occur. Configurations and event fields shown below are present. Ordinary regimes use moderate storage and timing; boundary uses equality/empty states; adversarial repeats stale/conflicting events; shift uses smaller capacity, longer timing gaps or deeper dependency shapes, without changing these rules. Generator regimes: Boundary byte capacity=2; shift capacity=4 versus ordinary 6, sizes 1..4 instead of 1..5, TTL 0..2 instead of 0..5 and clock steps 0..5 instead of 0..4. Adversarial traces add adjacent repeated events, capped at 48; those events obey the same contract.

matchedCard.label: Archival provenance and original order
matchedCard.relation: The origin and original arrangement of records preserve relationships that can be lost when the same contents are rearranged arbitrarily. A later description or arrangement is distinct from evidence of the organization in which the records were produced.
assumptions: The origin or original order is known or supported by evidence.
Relationships among records contribute to their interpretation.
matchedCard.boundary: Original order can be lost or disrupted. A newly devised arrangement does not establish that it was the historical arrangement, and provenance does not make every recorded claim true.
matchedCard.source_fact: The National Archives explains provenance, preserving or restoring original order, and devising arrangements when necessary, emphasizing the evidential significance of context.

shuffledCard.label: Seed banking
shuffledCard.relation: Preserving a reserve and preserving its ability to reactivate are different conditions. Suitable material remains in controlled storage, while periodic sample recovery provides evidence of continued viability. Duplicate holdings reduce dependence on one location.
assumptions: The material tolerates the chosen storage treatment.
Samples provide relevant evidence about the collection they represent.
Duplicate collections remain identifiable as corresponding holdings.
shuffledCard.boundary: Some material cannot survive drying or freezing. Successful retention alone does not demonstrate viability, and sampled viability is not certainty about every stored item.
shuffledCard.source_fact: Kew stores suitable dried seeds in cold vaults, periodically tests germination, and commonly duplicates holdings in their country of origin. Some seeds do not tolerate conventional storage.

sources.title: How to preserve seeds for the future

initial.explanation: Use the direct conditional rule: before each operation, remove expired entries; a successful put replaces the key, evicting oldest entries until capacity fits, while get refreshes recency. Advance also purges immediately after changing time. A put that exceeds capacity is a no-op.
initial.mapping: State maps now and an oldest-to-newest entry list. Each entry stores key, value, size, and expiry. Output derives from the current list, byte sum, time, and get result.
initial.assumptions: Expiry exists only for ttl>0; ttl=0 removes the key without insertion. The supplied fields are valid safe integers and event types are valid.
initial.holds: function holds(input,output){let c=input.config.capacity,s={n:0,a:[]};let out=[];function p(){s.a=s.a.filter(x=>x[3]>s.n)}function rm(k){s.a=s.a.filter(x=>x[0]!==k)}function emit(v){let b=0;for(let x of s.a)b+=x[2];out.push({value:v,keys:s.a.map(x=>x[0]),bytes:b,now:s.n})}for(let e of input.events){p();if(e.type==='advance'){s.n+=e.dt;p();emit(null)}else if(e.type==='get'){let i=s.a.findIndex(x=>x[0]===e.key),v=null;if(i>=0){let x=s.a[i];v=x[1];s.a.splice(i,1);s.a.push(x)}emit(v)}else{if(e.size<=c){rm(e.key);if(e.ttl>0){let b=0;for(let x of s.a)b+=x[2];while(s.a.length&&b+e.size>c){b-=s.a[0][2];s.a.shift()}s.a.push([e.key,e.value,e.size,s.n+e.ttl])}}emit(null)}}if(!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==out.length)return false;return JSON.stringify(output)===JSON.stringify(out)}
initial.program: function solve({config,state,event}){let s=state||{now:0,e:[]},n=s.now,a=s.e.map(x=>({k:x.k,v:x.v,z:x.z,t:x.t}));function purge(){a=a.filter(x=>x.t>n)}function remove(k){a=a.filter(x=>x.k!==k)}function result(v){let b=0;for(let x of a)b+=x.z;return{state:{now:n,e:a.map(x=>({k:x.k,v:x.v,z:x.z,t:x.t}))},output:{value:v,keys:a.map(x=>x.k),bytes:b,now:n}}}purge();if(event.type==='advance'){n+=event.dt;purge();return result(null)}if(event.type==='get'){let i=a.findIndex(x=>x.k===event.key);if(i<0)return result(null);let x=a[i];a.splice(i,1);a.push(x);return result(x.v)}if(event.size>config.capacity)return result(null);remove(event.key);if(event.ttl>0){let b=0;for(let x of a)b+=x.z;while(a.length&&b+event.size>config.capacity){b-=a[0].z;a.shift()}a.push({k:event.key,v:event.value,z:event.size,t:n+event.ttl})}return result(null)}

final.explanation: Maintains opaque state containing current time and oldest-to-newest entries. Each event first removes expired entries. Advance then purges again after increasing time. Gets return and refresh an entry’s recency. Valid puts replace the existing key, reject oversized values, remove the key for zero TTL, or evict oldest entries until the new value fits before inserting it.
final.program: function solve({config,state,event}){let s=state||{now:0,e:[]},n=s.now,a=s.e.map(x=>({k:x.k,v:x.v,z:x.z,t:x.t}));function purge(){a=a.filter(x=>x.t>n)}function remove(k){a=a.filter(x=>x.k!==k)}function result(v){let b=0;for(let x of a)b+=x.z;return{state:{now:n,e:a.map(x=>({k:x.k,v:x.v,z:x.z,t:x.t}))},output:{value:v,keys:a.map(x=>x.k),bytes:b,now:n}}}purge();if(event.type==='advance'){n+=event.dt;purge();return result(null)}if(event.type==='get'){let i=a.findIndex(x=>x.k===event.key);if(i<0)return result(null);let x=a[i];a.splice(i,1);a.push(x);return result(x.v)}if(event.size>config.capacity)return result(null);remove(event.key);if(event.ttl>0){let b=0;for(let x of a)b+=x.z;while(a.length&&b+event.size>config.capacity){b-=a[0].z;a.shift()}a.push({k:event.key,v:event.value,z:event.size,t:n+event.ttl})}return result(null)}

initial.explanation: Use a recency-ordered entry list. Expired entries are removed before each event and immediately after time advances. Oversized puts are no-ops; other puts replace, evict oldest entries as needed, and ttl=0 removes the key.
initial.mapping: Cache state maps now plus oldest-to-newest entries to key, value, size, and expiry. Output reports the current value result, recency keys, total bytes, and time.
initial.assumptions: Inputs satisfy the stated schema and safe-integer limits. State is only the JSON returned by this function.
initial.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;let s={now:0,e:[]},cap=input.config.capacity;function clean(){s.e=s.e.filter(x=>x.x>s.now)}function rem(k){let i=s.e.findIndex(x=>x.k===k);if(i>=0)s.e.splice(i,1)}function snap(v){return {value:v,keys:s.e.map(x=>x.k),bytes:s.e.reduce((a,x)=>a+x.z,0),now:s.now}}for(let i=0;i<input.events.length;i++){let q=input.events[i],v=null;clean();if(q.type==='advance'){s.now+=q.dt;clean()}else if(q.type==='get'){let j=s.e.findIndex(x=>x.k===q.key);if(j>=0){let x=s.e.splice(j,1)[0];v=x.v;s.e.push(x)}}else if(q.type==='put'&&q.size<=cap){rem(q.key);if(q.ttl>0){let b=s.e.reduce((a,x)=>a+x.z,0);while(s.e.length&&b+q.size>cap)b-=s.e.shift().z;s.e.push({k:q.key,v:q.value,z:q.size,x:s.now+q.ttl})}}let r=snap(v),o=output[i];if(JSON.stringify(r)!==JSON.stringify(o))return false}return true}

final.explanation: Maintain a recency-ordered array and current time. Remove expired entries before every event and again after advancing time. Oversized puts leave the cache unchanged; otherwise replace the key, evict oldest entries until the new entry fits, or remove it for zero TTL. Gets return the value and move the entry to newest.
final.program: function solve({config,state,event}){let s=state||{now:0,entries:[]},cap=config.capacity;function purge(){let a=[];for(let i=0;i<s.entries.length;i++)if(s.entries[i].expiry>s.now)a.push(s.entries[i]);s.entries=a}function remove(k){let a=[];for(let i=0;i<s.entries.length;i++)if(s.entries[i].key!==k)a.push(s.entries[i]);s.entries=a}function bytes(){let n=0;for(let i=0;i<s.entries.length;i++)n+=s.entries[i].size;return n}function output(value){let keys=[];for(let i=0;i<s.entries.length;i++)keys.push(s.entries[i].key);return{value:value,keys:keys,bytes:bytes(),now:s.now}}purge();let value=null;if(event.type==='advance'){s.now+=event.dt;purge()}else if(event.type==='get'){for(let i=0;i<s.entries.length;i++)if(s.entries[i].key===event.key){let x=s.entries.splice(i,1)[0];s.entries.push(x);value=x.value;break}}else if(event.type==='put'&&event.size<=cap){remove(event.key);if(event.ttl>0){let total=bytes();while(s.entries.length&&total+event.size>cap)total-=s.entries.shift().size;s.entries.push({key:event.key,value:event.value,size:event.size,expiry:s.now+event.ttl})}}return{state:s,output:output(value)}}

initial.explanation: Maintain a clock and an oldest-to-newest recency list. Expired entries are removed before each event; advancing also removes entries expired at the new time. Valid puts remove the old key, evict oldest entries until the byte budget fits, then append the new entry.
initial.mapping: config.capacity maps to the byte budget; state.now is time; state.entries is recency order with key, value, size, and expiry. Event type selects put, get, or advance. Output reports the resulting value, keys, byte sum, and time.
initial.assumptions: State is trusted only as the state previously returned by this function. All supplied numeric values satisfy the stated safe-integer constraints. Expiry is inclusive: expiry<=now means expired.
initial.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;var s=null;for(var i=0;i<output.length;i++){var r=solve({config:input.config,state:s,event:input.events[i]});if(JSON.stringify(r.output)!==JSON.stringify(output[i]))return false;s=r.state}return true}
initial.program: function solve(x){var c=x.config,e=x.event,s=x.state;if(!s)s={now:0,entries:[]};else{s={now:s.now,entries:s.entries.map(function(a){return{key:a.key,value:a.value,size:a.size,exp:a.exp}})}}function clean(){s.entries=s.entries.filter(function(a){return a.exp>s.now})}function idx(k){for(var i=0;i<s.entries.length;i++)if(s.entries[i].key===k)return i;return-1}function out(v){var b=0,k=[];for(var i=0;i<s.entries.length;i++){b+=s.entries[i].size;k.push(s.entries[i].key)}return{state:s,output:{value:v,keys:k,bytes:b,now:s.now}}}clean();var t=e.type;if(t==='advance'){s.now+=e.dt;clean();return out(null)}if(t==='get'){var j=idx(e.key);if(j<0)return out(null);var a=s.entries.splice(j,1)[0];s.entries.push(a);return out(a.value)}if(t==='put'){if(e.size>c.capacity)return out(null);var j=idx(e.key);if(j>=0)s.entries.splice(j,1);if(e.ttl===0)return out(null);var b=0;for(var i=0;i<s.entries.length;i++)b+=s.entries[i].size;while(s.entries.length&&b+e.size>c.capacity)b-=s.entries.shift().size;s.entries.push({key:e.key,value:e.value,size:e.size,exp:s.now+e.ttl});return out(null)}return out(null)}

final.explanation: Tracks current time and an oldest-to-newest entry array. Expired entries are removed before every event and again after advancing. Valid nonzero-TTL puts remove any existing key, evict oldest entries until the new item fits, then append it as newest. Oversized puts do nothing; zero-TTL puts remove the key. Gets return the value and refresh recency.
final.program: function solve(x){var c=x.config,e=x.event,s=x.state;if(s==null)s={now:0,entries:[]};else s={now:s.now,entries:s.entries.map(function(a){return{key:a.key,value:a.value,size:a.size,exp:a.exp}})};function clean(){var a=[];for(var i=0;i<s.entries.length;i++)if(s.entries[i].exp>s.now)a.push(s.entries[i]);s.entries=a}function find(k){for(var i=0;i<s.entries.length;i++)if(s.entries[i].key===k)return i;return-1}function result(v){var keys=[],bytes=0;for(var i=0;i<s.entries.length;i++){keys.push(s.entries[i].key);bytes+=s.entries[i].size}return{state:s,output:{value:v,keys:keys,bytes:bytes,now:s.now}}}clean();if(e.type==='advance'){s.now+=e.dt;clean();return result(null)}if(e.type==='get'){var j=find(e.key);if(j<0)return result(null);var a=s.entries.splice(j,1)[0];s.entries.push(a);return result(a.value)}if(e.type==='put'){if(e.size>c.capacity)return result(null);var j=find(e.key);if(j>=0)s.entries.splice(j,1);if(e.ttl===0)return result(null);var bytes=0;for(var i=0;i<s.entries.length;i++)bytes+=s.entries[i].size;while(bytes+e.size>c.capacity){bytes-=s.entries.shift().size}s.entries.push({key:e.key,value:e.value,size:e.size,exp:s.now+e.ttl});return result(null)}return result(null)}
